question: Which of the five has been most explicit about serving mass-affluent clients, and what exactly have they said?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones offers a variety of different solutions to clients, including investment advisory programs, brokerage and retirement accounts, cash and lending solutions and financial planning offerings.
items.quote: The Partnership offers a variety of different solutions to clients, including investment advisory programs, brokerage and retirement accounts, cash and lending solutions and financial planning offerings.

items.text: Edward Jones serves clients through branch teams across the U.S. and Canada, designed to serve clients through deep, personal relationships and comprehensive advice and planning.
items.quote: The Partnership's branch office model is designed to serve clients through deep, personal relationships and comprehensive advice and planning with financial advisors and client support team professionals ("CSTPs") located in the communities where clients live and work.

items.text: Edward Jones derives revenues from fees for providing investment advisory and other account services, fees for assets held by clients, and commissions for the distribution of mutual fund shares and insurance products and the purchase or sale of securities.
items.quote: primarily derives revenues from fees for providing investment advisory and other account services to its clients, fees for assets held by clients and commissions for the distribution of mutual fund shares and insurance products and the purchase or sale of securities.

items.text: Trust services are offered to Edward Jones' U.S. clients through Edward Jones Trust Company, and Olive Street Investment Advisers provides investment advisory services to its money market fund and the Bridge Builder Trust sub-advised mutual funds.
items.quote: Trust services are offered to Edward Jones' U.S. clients through Edward Jones Trust Company... Olive Street Investment Advisers, LLC... provides investment advisory services to the Edward Jones Money Market Fund... and the twelve sub-advised mutual funds comprising the Bridge Builder® Trust.

items.text: Edward Jones' fee revenue is composed of asset-based fees and account and activity fees; asset-based fees include advisory program fees based on the average daily market value of client assets, and cash solutions fees.
items.quote: Asset-based fees include advisory program fees which are based on the average daily market value of client assets in the program, as well as contractual rates.

cells.reason: The passages describe the general products and services Edward Jones offers to clients, but none specifically reference mass-affluent clients as a distinct segment; the products described are for clients broadly.
